notes: Ethereum mainnet launch of imdDRONE (DRONE) paired with IMD. DroneHook is a plain immutable contract: no owner, admin, proxy, upgrade, pause, blocklist, allowlist, wallet or transaction limit, per-address logic, or DELEGATECALL in the hook, token or optional CREATE2 helper. The manifest names the hook itself; it is deployed directly by CREATE2 at an address carrying mask 0x20cc (beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta), which the constructor validates with Hooks.validateHookPermissions. Constructor arguments in declaration order: IPoolManager ($poolManager), IMD address (the paired currency), launch token ($token). beforeInitialize accepts calls only from the PoolManager, once, for the IMD/DRONE pair at static LP fee 12500 and tick spacing 60 with this hook, and records openedAt. The 1.25% LP fee is untouched: no dynamic-fee flag, no updateDynamicLPFee, zero LP-fee override. Hook fee constants: KEEPER_FEE=300, OPENING_FEE=4000, OPENING_SECONDS=3600 bps. Rate = 300 + floor(3700*(3600-elapsed)/3600) for the first hour after initialization, then exactly 300 forever; identical for every address, for buys and sells, exact input and exact output. The fee is always taken in IMD on the swap's gross IMD amount (IMD paid in on buys, IMD paid out on sells), whichever side IMD is on: via the beforeSwap specified delta when IMD is the specified currency, via the afterSwap unspecified delta otherwise. SpecifiedAmount quotes partial fills read-only so unused input is not charged. Fees accrue as ERC-6909 IMD claims minted to the hook inside the PoolManager; nothing is transferred during the swap, so swaps work on a manager holding no IMD. sweep() is permissionless, burns the claims and takes the IMD, plus any loose IMD, to the constant keeper 0x086b47d05aae785f871191c1198231e9e6033c64, which cannot change; called reentrantly or while the manager is unlocked it returns 0 without reverting. Views: feeNow(), openedAt(), pending(), collected(). No hook state can revert a swap; the one extra input limit is an exact-output request within a fee of int256.max (R-01 in docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md). DroneToken: no constructor arguments, 18 decimals, fixed 10^27 units minted to its deployer, ordinary transfers, no mint, tax, owner or proxy. initialPrice 2^96 is a 1 IMD per DRONE assumption (both 18 decimals); the hook does not constrain price. Deploy the hook and initialize the pool in one transaction so nobody else starts the opening clock. The imdDRONES reward contract is deployed separately and is unknown to this launch; it is funded by an ordinary DRONE transfer from whatever the launch policy leaves to the requester. Supply and allocation are launch-policy matters, not manifest fields. Evidence: forge test 48 passed; mainnet fork at block 26140740 bought and sold through the real PoolManager against real IMD; independent review published in docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md, local record in docs/VERIFICATION.md.
